get.description: Default-off cookie-only private discovery. One current canonical Session/Run/actor read, no idle activity refresh, query parameters, body or query disclosure. Returns an opaque pending selector or authenticated absence; errors are never absence. Encoded response at most 2048 bytes, no-store, no ETag. Not a decision or dispatch capability.

200.description: Current private selector or authenticated absence

get.description: Default-off private exact-query view. First-party cookie only; tenant/actor are resolved in the original Store without activity refresh. No query parameters or body. Encoded response at most 8192 bytes, no-store, no ETag. Discovery supplies opaque selectors only; worker wait remains separate. This view is not approval or egress authority.

200.description: Original query after current actor and resource-authority revalidation

post.description: Default-off immutable decision CAS using established cookie/header CSRF equality and exact Origin. Store rechecks current actor, stored CSRF, original claim and all original windows. No query or receipt is returned. Identical retries recover the original decision, never a send capability. Body at most 512 bytes; exact keys/casing, no duplicates or trailing values.

200.description: Confirmed original immutable decision summary, no dispatch authority
Credential-free compute availability for this session

get.description: Participant READ-authorized exact Run evidence, design 0.1.2. Selector only: no query or body. Default-off until writer/schema cutover. No compute, retry or cancellation authority. Maximum 16 KiB; no ETag or 304.

429.description: Authenticated user/tenant rate limit, without resource details

200.description: Fresh owner-scoped drain or revoke plan

query.description: Exact decoded query, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; private browser memory only, not public execution evidence.

ComputeChoicesPageV1.description: Unmounted compute-choice contract. Shape is not authorization, eligibility, reservation or execution. Producer reauthorizes and joins all current evidence. Encoded response is limited to 16384 UTF-8 bytes including JSON escaping.

choices.description: Distinct visible opaque choice IDs; zero entries permitted. No entitled inventory total.

next_cursor.description: Canonical bounded CursorV1 encoding, below 512-byte ceiling. Shape does not prove MAC/scope; issuer caps at 60s and shortest required authority expiry.

ComputeChoiceV1.description: Real source windows are all-or-none; observed_at <= read_at and valid_until > observed_at. Current iff read_at < valid_until (expired at equality). Producer supplies shortest required expiry; missing evidence never invents timestamps. Unknown semantic evidence may retain a real window. Eligible requires all current predicates and supported input_kind, not just this shape.

ComputeChoiceLabelV1.description: Operator-reviewed UTF-8 display copy, at most 128 encoded bytes (not merely code points), without leading/trailing space, control or format characters. No endpoint/host/account/credential-derived copy. Syntactic validation cannot certify review.

text.const: The selected provider processes the entire admitted conversation context and new input as private data. The execution host operator can technically access admitted data. Only the listed input kinds are supported. No alternate resource or provider is selected automatically.

ComputeChoiceDisclosureV1.description: Disclosure of whole-context private processing and host-operator access; listing is not acknowledgement, provider terms approval, a use grant or later tool/search consent.

ComputeChoiceCapacityV1.description: Current source-window-only availability observation, not a reservation. Missing required source is unknown without fabricated timestamps. No quantities, quota, invoice, price, budget, free/unlimited assertion or other member information.

run_id.description: Optional authorized canonical Run correlation; generic unlinked events omit it.

AttachedWorkerUint64V1.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal string; encoded as text to preserve browser precision.
